_meta.what: Coder-assigned psycholinguistic ratings, 1-7, one call per word, out of context. Findings K.
_meta.NOT_HUMAN_NORMS: These are ONE MODEL's judgments at ONE frozen instrument version -- not Warriner, not Brysbaert. They carry an inter-annotator band and two scales are not established. Do not present them beside human norms as the same kind of object; the k_ prefix exists to keep that visible at the call site.

NOT_ESTABLISHED.register_level: weakest on three independent measures -- IAA 0.60, rank stability 0.62 when rated alone, z 1.0 against its own null. Usable as a descriptor, not as evidence.
NOT_ESTABLISHED.vulgarity: a SPARSE INDICATOR: variance on 463 of 27,242 English words. Correlates with register at +0.000 among non-coarse words and -0.571 among coarse ones. Its floor effects are NOT nulls.

_meta.level_vs_rank: Charge and concreteness shift in LEVEL between instrument versions (2.29->2.58, 3.83->4.06 when rated alone) while holding their ORDER (r 0.88). Use ranks; never threshold on an absolute value.
